user_goal: Execute Forschungsbefehl 1 as an intensive Global J-Space steering research cycle and create the highest-information nonduplicate executable delta available to this organ.

trigger1_authority.positive_claim_boundary: Actual model/runtime consumption plus exact identity, matched controls, disjoint holdout and reproducible directional effect are required; prompt-only influence is insufficient.

prior_cycle_reentry.cycle1_primary_path: Qwen3-0.6B local intervention baseline followed by Qwen3.5-0.8B adapter transfer
prior_cycle_reentry.this_cycle_nonduplication: Adds a hosted output-logit vector intervention discriminator rather than duplicating the local residual/cvec path.

new_hypothesis.statement: A provider API that explicitly consumes a token-id logit-bias vector before sampling can provide a cheap, directly consumed output-layer vector-control discriminator, even though it does not establish hidden-state/J-Space control.
new_hypothesis.prediction: On one exact fixed model/tokenizer/provider route, +VECTOR versus SIGN_FLIP/NULL/ORTHOGONAL/PERMUTED controls will produce direction-specific log-probability/output changes under fixed seeds if the vector is actually consumed.
new_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Hosted parameter routing, tokenizer ambiguity, provider fallback or output-layer-only effects make the intervention nonreproducible or irrelevant to the intended J-Space mechanism.
new_hypothesis.credit_boundary: OUTPUT_LOGIT_VECTOR_CONTROL_COMPONENT_ONLY; no hidden-state, J-Space model-runtime, HCU-full, EntityOS-whole or training credit.

external_evidence.finding: OpenRouter documents logit_bias as a token-id to bias mapping applied to logits before sampling; supported values are bounded and model/tokenizer specific.
OpenRouter provider routing exposes require_parameters to exclude providers that do not support requested parameters and allow_fallbacks to control fallback behavior.
llama.cpp exposes native control-vector, scaled-control-vector and layer-range controls, preserving the stronger local hidden/residual intervention path as the primary full Trigger-1 mechanism.

repository_observations.finding_1: The current generic provider request body carries model/messages/max_tokens/temperature/stream only; it has no Trigger-1 vector parameter surface.
repository_observations.finding_2: OpenRouter is currently admitted only through openrouter/free, which is a dynamic free router. That route is economically zero-price bound but cannot provide the exact fixed model/tokenizer identity required for reproducible Trigger-1 steering.
repository_observations.finding_3: A concurrent current-main delta binds one exact NVIDIA credential to three hosted-NIM model routes, improving FREE execution economics but not exposing a hidden-state/cvec API intervention surface.

writes.scope: Network-free fail-closed discriminator; creates BASELINE/+VECTOR/SIGN_FLIP/NULL/ORTHOGONAL/PERMUTED control family; rejects dynamic openrouter/free; requires exact zero-price route, exact tokenizer digest, fixed seed, require_parameters=true and allow_fallbacks=false before request construction.
Regression definitions for exact-route failure, control geometry, parameter-consumption routing flags, baseline behavior and tokenizer identity.

local_functional_reconstruction.note: The local test reconstructed the committed pure-stdlib functions/tests from the inspected source. It is not promoted as an exact-source canonical runtime receipt.

scientific_result.positive: Hosted output-logit vector control is a plausible cheaper causal discriminator and is implementable without weakening the local cvec path.
scientific_result.negative: The currently admitted openrouter/free route is scientifically inadequate for Trigger-1 reproducibility because exact model/tokenizer identity is unresolved.
scientific_result.next_discriminator: Bind one exact OpenRouter model route with provider-side zero-price evidence plus exact tokenizer identity and documented logit_bias support, then run the matched control family; otherwise keep this lane blocked and execute the local Qwen3-0.6B cvec/residual T1 path.

concurrent_evidence_note: Current main also contains a separate Forschungsbefehl-1 causal-grounding sweep and a post-supervisor-inbox NVIDIA credential-entitlement delta. These are treated as parallel donor evidence, not as this organ's runtime execution.
